tasks.subject: Task 1: Prepare verified assets
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create a self-contained content and asset foundation with current contact details, résumé, fonts and optimized project imagery.

**Files:**
- Create: `assets/fonts/*`, `assets/images/*`, `scripts/verify_content.py`
- Replace: `Jenil-resume.pdf`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Current résumé extracts `jmakwana@cs.cmu.edu`.
- [ ] Images are web-sized and sourced.
- [ ] Fonts are local.
- [ ] Verification rejects stale contacts, typos, em dashes and missing metrics.

**Verify:** `python3 scripts/verify_content.py` prints `content verification passed`.

```json:metadata
{"files":["assets/fonts","assets/images","Jenil-resume.pdf","scripts/verify_content.py"],"verifyCommand":"python3 scripts/verify_content.py","acceptanceCriteria":["Current resume and contact details","Locally hosted fonts and sourced images","Content verification passes"],"modelTier":"standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Build responsive portfolio
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the Bootstrap page with the full semantic single-page portfolio and distinct personal visual system.

**Files:**
- Replace: `index.html`, `style.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Hero, proof strip and three case studies present verified fit.
- [ ] Experience, capabilities, education and contact are current.
- [ ] No overflow at 375px, 768px or 1440px.
- [ ] Personal palette is warm paper, graphite and copper.

**Verify:** Serve with `python3 -m http.server 4173` and inspect the three target widths.

```json:metadata
{"files":["index.html","style.css"],"verifyCommand":"python3 -m http.server 4173","acceptanceCriteria":["All planned sections render","Responsive at three target widths","Distinct personal visual identity"],"modelTier":"frontier"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Add accessible interactions
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add subtle navigation and reveal behavior while keeping the page fully usable without JavaScript.

**Files:**
- Create: `script.js`, `scripts/verify_markup.py`
- Modify: `index.html`, `style.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Mobile menu is keyboard-operable.
- [ ] Reduced motion is respected.
- [ ] Semantic landmarks, heading order, alt text and safe external links pass verification.
- [ ] Content remains visible without JavaScript.

**Verify:** `python3 scripts/verify_markup.py` prints `markup verification passed`.

```json:metadata
{"files":["script.js","scripts/verify_markup.py","index.html","style.css"],"verifyCommand":"python3 scripts/verify_markup.py","acceptanceCriteria":["Accessible navigation","Reduced-motion behavior","Markup verification passes"],"modelTier":"standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Verify and publish Pages
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the final site works locally and publish the exact verified commit through GitHub Pages.

**Files:**
- Create: `.nojekyll`, `README.md`
- Modify: GitHub Pages repository settings only if necessary

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Desktop and mobile renders have no visible defects.
- [ ] Both verification scripts pass from a clean checkout.
- [ ] The pushed commit is served at the existing Pages URL.
- [ ] Production has current email, working assets and no console errors.

**Verify:** `python3 scripts/verify_content.py && python3 scripts/verify_markup.py` plus production browser inspection.

```json:metadata
{"files":[".nojekyll","README.md"],"verifyCommand":"python3 scripts/verify_content.py && python3 scripts/verify_markup.py","acceptanceCriteria":["Local verification passes","Production Pages URL serves pushed commit","Production visual inspection passes"],"modelTier":"standard"}
```
